description: Negative wire-acceptance corpus: documents that no SDK's untrusted JSON entry point may accept as a valid bundle or session token. See README.md for the acceptance contract.

cases.name: duplicate_key_top_level
cases.description: agent_id appears twice in the top-level bundle object

cases.name: duplicate_key_escaped
cases.description: agent_id spelled once with a Unicode escape and once literally in the same object

cases.name: unknown_field_bundle
cases.description: extra app_metadata member inside the signed ProofBundle object

cases.name: integer_above_domain
cases.description: challenge_at = 2^53, one above the safe-integer maximum

cases.name: integer_below_domain
cases.description: challenge_at = -2^53, one below the safe-integer minimum

cases.name: wrong_length_ed25519_key
cases.description: agent_pub_key.ed25519 decodes to 3 bytes instead of 32

cases.name: malformed_base64
cases.description: challenge is not valid standard base64

cases.name: empty_delegations
cases.description: delegations is an empty array; chain depth must be in [1, MAX]

cases.name: malformed_utf8
cases.description: 0xFF byte inside a string value; never valid UTF-8

cases.name: bom_prefixed
cases.description: UTF-8 BOM before an otherwise valid bundle; U+FEFF is invalid JSON

cases.name: token_unknown_field
cases.description: extra member inside the signed SessionToken object

cases.name: token_integer_above_domain
cases.description: issued_at = 2^53, one above the safe-integer maximum
